title: Naaman and the Servant Girl
reflectionQuestion: A little servant girl helped someone in a great big way. What is a kind thing you could do for someone, even a small one?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (extra, emotional room = A CHILD CAN CHANGE A LIFE + humility). The hero is the little servant girl -- brave, kind to a man who was NOT always kind to her (Adam's key angle); routes a feeling_small child to 'even the smallest person matters.' Leprosy softened to 'a sickness on his skin' (no spots, like 1853). Naaman's pride/anger softened to grumpy-then-humble (no rage). The seven dips = the repetition kids love + suspense. longEligible=TRUE (upgraded 2026-06-20: the servant girl + journey + insulting muddy-river + pride->humility + 7 dips genuinely grows). Will get short+full+long. 'God' throughout, no Yahweh (Elisha is God's prophet; name not the point). VOICE_HANNAH_HOPE (bright, hopeful -- the little girl's faith).

scriptureKeyVerse.text: Then went he down and dipped himself seven times in the Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God; and his flesh was restored like the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.
